chief_complaint.text: Severe sore throat with fever, cough and body ache
suggestions: Consider documenting symptom duration more precisely

history_of_present_illness.text: Symptoms started 3 days ago with mild fever, which increased to 101°F yesterday evening. Took 650mg paracetamol twice, which provided temporary relief.

past_history.text: Hypertension diagnosed 5 years ago, on Amlodipine 5mg once daily

family_history.text: Father has diabetes, mother has hypertension

drug_allergy.text: Allergic to penicillin, causes skin rashes

clinical_examination.text: Temperature 100.8°F, Pulse 92/min, BP 132/84 mmHg, SpO2 98%, mild dry cough, breathlessness on exertion
suggestions: Consider documenting more detailed examination findings
clinical_examination.general_examination: No swelling, skin rashes or severe weakness
clinical_examination.systemic_examination: Mild infection in upper respiratory tract, no worrying symptoms related to heart, stomach or nervous system

diagnosis.text: Acute viral upper respiratory tract infection
items: Acute viral upper respiratory tract infection

investigations.text: May need CBC, CRP, COVID-19 or influenza test, and chest X-ray if symptoms worsen

prescription.text: Paracetamol 650mg for fever, Amlodipine 5mg once daily, Levocetirizine 5mg once nightly for 5 days
suggestions: Consider documenting potential side effects of medications

advice.text: Rest, drink enough water, eat nutritious food, wear mask, gargle with warm salt water, steam inhalation twice daily

follow_up.text: Follow up after 3 days, or earlier if symptoms worsen
follow_up.instruction: Follow up after 3 days, or earlier if symptoms worsen
